answers.eng_dens01_0668:
My Weekend Plan
This weekend I have a busy but happy plan. On Saturday morning I will finish my homework and read an English story for twenty minutes. In the afternoon I will help my parents clean the living room and wash the dishes. After that I will play basketball with my classmates for about one hour. On Sunday I am going to the library to borrow some story books and relax by listening to music. I hope I can keep this plan and enjoy a wonderful weekend.
